retraction.reason: Retracted in M30a-2 and re-filed as the tenure "joao-franco-liberal-regenerator-party-1901": who led a body is an office somebody held and not a link between two actors, because a relation's id is from--to--type and one person may lead one body more than once. The type "led" is deprecated and no active relation may take it; nothing this record claimed was changed in the move.

note: Founded by him on 16 May 1901 after his break with Hintze Ribeiro. The end is the party record's own and was not read in a source.
